meta.description: Retailers selling smartphones and consumer electronics in Belgium, France, the Netherlands and Germany.
meta.inclusion_rule: Based in Europe: headquartered in a European country, or an in-market European legal entity (entity_basis=eu_subsidiary). Non-European shops that only ship to Europe are excluded (see excluded.json).
meta.exhaustiveness: Curated seed of the main national and pan-European chains, pure players, marketplaces, telecom operators, brand stores and refurbishers. Thousands of small independent shops also exist; add them to this file (or with scripts/add_retailer.py) and run pricetracker.verify.
meta.verification: All entries start as 'unverified'. Run `python -m pricetracker.verify --write` from a machine with internet access.
